segments.he: מִנְחָה דּוּמְיָא דְּאָשָׁם וְחַטָּאת, מָה אָשָׁם וְחַטָּאת טְעוּנִין כְּלִי, אַף מִנְחָה נָמֵי טְעוּנָה כְּלִי.
segments.en: Rabbi Yehuda HaNasi explains: The verse compares the meal offering to the guilt offering and the sin offering, indicating that the halakha of the «meal offering is similar to» the halakha of the «guilt offering and the sin offering. Just as» the «guilt offering and» the «sin offering require» the use of a service «vessel» in order to cook the sacrificial meat, and this is performed inside the Temple courtyard, «so too,» the «meal offering also requires» a service «vessel» for its preparation, which is performed inside the Temple courtyard.

moves.summary: as guilt and sin offerings need a vessel, so does the meal offering
